note: Expected verdicts derived case by case from the judge-v2 rules, before any v2 run. Development data: these 46 pairs produced the rules and can never produce a published agreement figure. A mismatch is classified as rubric ambiguity (fix the wording, log it) or judge error (record it, change nothing). The wording is not iterated toward a perfect score here - the held-out run is the test.

excluded.q-product-how-to-look-after-it: Merges care advice from four cited sources that read as different products, but the dataset carries no product identifier of any kind, so the premise cannot be established. Excluded rather than asserted.

why.q-billing-auto-renewal-surprise: grounded - 'annual' restates this customer's own account ('the next twelve months'), and they are authoritative about their own experience
why.q-billing-charged-after-stopping: ungrounded - 'we can assist in refunding any payments taken since your intended cancellation date' promises a specific outcome from a past-tense resolution
why.q-billing-more-people-more-cost: ungrounded - asserts the precedent's circumstance ('the additional seats were added on different days') as this customer's fact
why.q-billing-bank-took-extra: grounded - hedged cause, and 'slightly higher' restates the customer's own account
why.q-login-phone-replaced-no-codes: grounded - 'enrolments are tied to the device' is verbatim in the resolution and phrased generally
why.q-login-too-many-tries-now-blocked: ungrounded - the causal link between wrong attempts and the lock appears in no resolution; the customer is authoritative only that they typed it wrong
why.q-login-two-registrations: grounded - hedged, restates the customer's account, and uses the precedent as a similar case
why.q-login-joined-but-empty: ungrounded - promises a fix and its timing from a past-tense resolution
why.q-fault-callbacks-stopped: ungrounded - asserts the precedent's circumstances and actions as this customer's facts
why.q-parcel-missing: grounded - hedged possibility, similar-case framing, and 'a replacement is sent' is phrased as policy
why.q-shipping-postage-more-than-quoted: ungrounded - asserts the precedent's oversized item as this customer's order
why.q-shipping-need-different-address: grounded - 'cannot be altered' is phrased as policy; 'your new address' restates the customer
why.q-refund-missing: grounded - 'commonly three to five working days' is phrased as policy
why.q-returns-money-back-short: ungrounded - one past-tense case stated as a general rule; the hedge attaches to the circumstances, not the claim
why.q-returns-decided-against-it: ungrounded - 'the item is perfectly good' bears on eligibility and needs attribution or resolution support
why.q-returns-how-do-i-send-back: grounded - the resolution states the process in general terms
why.q-returns-bought-as-present: grounded - gift-reference policy is phrased generally in the resolution
why.q-product-no-instructions-in-box: ungrounded - 'a printed copy has been posted to you' asserts a precedent action as done for this customer
why.q-billing-promo-ignored: ungrounded - 'in such cases, the discount is applied retrospectively' generalises a past-tense single case
why.q-login-reset-mail-never-came: ungrounded - 'common reasons' adds prevalence and 'ensure future messages arrive normally' is a guarantee
why.q-login-keeps-logging-me-out: ungrounded - 'one common cause' adds a prevalence claim no resolution makes
why.q-fault-nothing-saves: ungrounded - 'you will be notified' is a different claim from 'failures now block the confirmation message'
why.q-shipping-tracking-frozen: ungrounded - a prediction about this parcel's outcome; hedging does not license predictions
why.q-shipping-only-some-items: grounded - everything material is hedged or similar-case framed; 'caused confusion' asserts no cause of the reported problem, no policy, amount, timeline, eligibility or action, so it is immaterial
why.q-product-what-size-should-i-get: ungrounded - 'this line' and 'this design' expanded to 'our sizing' generally
